sources.title: Historical boundaries of world countries and cultural regions
cautions: The source repository explicitly describes the maps as work in progress.
Ancient files mix political entities with cultural and ethnographic regions.
Editorial snapshot years sometimes use the nearest available source geometry rather than an exact-year reconstruction.

sources.title: world-atlas countries-50m
usedFor: modern coastline and faint present-day reference boundaries
cautions: Present-day borders are rendered faintly and should not be interpreted as ancient boundaries.
